# pi-tools debugging

Use when the cause of wrong behavior is not already known. State the observed and expected behavior with evidence, form a specific falsifiable hypothesis, and test it against the real system. Refute or refine hypotheses until the root cause—not merely its symptom—is established.

<!-- awf:edit oracle-and-handoff: default; create .awf/skills/parts/debugging/oracle-and-handoff.md to override -->
## Oracle and handoff

Before mutating a fix, establish the strongest practical durable regression oracle against unfixed behavior. The only earlier mutation allowed is adding that oracle. Prefer a deterministic automated red-then-green test; when impractical, record why and use the strongest reproducible alternative. Do not alter expected output to accommodate a defect.

Once root cause and oracle are established, route the fix to `pi-tools-implementing`. If investigation reveals an unresolved material design choice, route it to brainstorming instead. TDD and bugfix investigation are part of this procedure, not separate gates.
